name: Tableau
description: Tableau Cloud and Server: find workbooks, views and data sources, read view data as CSV, images and PDFs, query published data sources, trace lineage, manage projects, tags, group members and extract refreshes.
instructions:
## Tableau
This connector works with **Tableau Cloud** and **Tableau Server** (2024.2 or later) through the REST API 3.23, the VizQL Data Service and the Metadata API: sites, projects, workbooks, views (data as CSV, images, PDFs, Excel crosstabs), published data sources and their fields, queries on data sources, lineage, users and groups, background jobs and extract refreshes.

**Setup (5 minutes)**
1. In Tableau open your **Account Settings**, section **Personal Access Tokens**, enter a token name and click **Create Token**. Copy the name into `TABLEAU_PAT_NAME` and the secret (shown once) into `TABLEAU_PAT_SECRET`. On Tableau Server an admin may have to allow personal access tokens first.
2. `TABLEAU_SERVER_URL`: the address without a path, e.g. `https://prod-useast-a.online.tableau.com` (Tableau Cloud: the pod host you see in the browser) or `https://tableau.example.com`.
3. `TABLEAU_SITE`: the site's content URL, the part after `/site/` in the browser address (`#/site/acme/home` gives `acme`). For the Default site of a Tableau Server leave it empty.
4. Run `tableau_get_current_session` to check the sign-in.

The connector signs in with the token and reuses the session; it signs in again when the session expires. Tableau allows one session per token at a time, so do not use the same token in another tool, and Tableau Cloud revokes a token that has not been used for 15 days (create a new one then).

**Workflow**
- Start with `tableau_get_current_session`: `site.id` is the `site_id` every site tool needs. `tableau_get_server_info`, `tableau_list_sites` and `tableau_get_site` describe the server and site.
- Find content: `tableau_search_content` (words, with type filters), `tableau_list_projects`, `tableau_list_workbooks`, `tableau_get_workbook`, `tableau_list_workbook_views`, `tableau_list_views`, `tableau_get_view`, `tableau_list_workbook_connections`.
- Read what a dashboard shows: `tableau_get_view_data` (CSV of the marks), `tableau_get_view_image` (PNG to look at), `tableau_get_view_pdf`, `tableau_download_view_crosstab_excel`, `tableau_get_workbook_pdf`. Narrow them with `filters` such as `{"vf_Region": "West"}`.
- Query data directly: `tableau_list_datasources`, `tableau_get_datasource`, `tableau_list_datasource_connections`, then `tableau_read_datasource_metadata` for the field captions and `tableau_query_datasource` to aggregate and filter them (VizQL Data Service).
- Lineage and impact: `tableau_metadata_query` (GraphQL on the Metadata API, for example which workbooks use a table).
- People: `tableau_list_users`, `tableau_get_user`, `tableau_list_user_groups`, `tableau_list_groups`, `tableau_list_group_users`, `tableau_add_user_to_group`.
- Refreshes and jobs: `tableau_list_extract_refresh_tasks`, `tableau_run_extract_refresh_task`, `tableau_refresh_workbook`, `tableau_refresh_datasource`, then `tableau_list_jobs` and `tableau_get_job` to follow them; `tableau_cancel_job` stops one.
- Organize: `tableau_create_project`, `tableau_update_project`, `tableau_update_workbook`, `tableau_move_workbook`, `tableau_add_workbook_tags`, `tableau_add_datasource_tags`.

**Switched off at install**: `tableau_cancel_job`; it cannot be undone, so an admin switches it on when the team needs it.

**Reading the answers**: ids are LUIDs (UUIDs). Lists come as `{"pagination": {"pageNumber", "pageSize", "totalAvailable"}, "workbooks": {"workbook": [...]}}` (the same for projects, views, datasources, users, groups, jobs). Times are ISO 8601 in UTC. `tableau_get_view_data` returns CSV text with a header row; numbers are formatted as in the view. `tableau_query_datasource` returns `data` as a list of objects keyed by field caption (with the function, e.g. `SUM(Sales)`). A job's `finishCode` is 0 for success, 1 for failure, 2 for cancelled.

**Paging**: list tools take `page_size` (up to 1000) and `page_number`; continue while `pageNumber * pageSize` is below `totalAvailable`. `tableau_search_content` pages with `limit` and `page`; its answer carries the total and the next page.

**Filters and sorting**: `filter` is `field:operator:value`, several joined by commas, e.g. `projectName:eq:Finance,updatedAt:gt:2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`; `in` takes `[a,b]`. `sort` is `field:asc` or `field:desc`.

**Limits and requirements**: `tableau_read_datasource_metadata` and `tableau_query_datasource` need Tableau Cloud or Tableau Server 2025.1 with the VizQL Data Service on, and the API Access capability on the data source. `tableau_metadata_query` needs the Metadata API (on by default on Tableau Cloud; enabled by an admin on Server). `tableau_search_content` needs Tableau Cloud or Server 2022.3 and later. Content Tableau returns is limited to what the token's user may see.

**Errors**: Tableau answers `{"error": {"code", "summary", "detail"}}`. 401 (codes 401001 and 401002) means a wrong or expired token or wrong site content URL; 403 a user without permission; 404 (404000 to 404xxx) a wrong id or a site_id from another site; 400 a bad filter or parameter; 409 a duplicate name or a refresh that is already queued.
prerequisites: A Tableau Cloud site or Tableau Server 2024.2 or later, and a personal access token of a user who can see the content.

TABLEAU_SERVER_URL.label: Tableau address
TABLEAU_SERVER_URL.help: Tableau Cloud: the pod host from the browser, e.g. https://prod-useast-a.online.tableau.com. Tableau Server: its address, without a path.
TABLEAU_SERVER_URL.patternMessage: Enter only the scheme and host, e.g. https://prod-useast-a.online.tableau.com, without #/site/... or another path.

TABLEAU_SITE.label: Site content URL
TABLEAU_SITE.help: The part after /site/ in the browser address (#/site/acme/home gives acme). Empty for the Default site of a Tableau Server.

TABLEAU_PAT_NAME.label: Token name
TABLEAU_PAT_NAME.help: Account Settings, Personal Access Tokens: the name you gave the token.

TABLEAU_PAT_SECRET.label: Token secret
TABLEAU_PAT_SECRET.help: The token secret, shown once when the token is created.

verifyHints.401: Tableau refused the sign-in: check the token name and secret (they are case-sensitive), the site content URL, and that the token has not expired or been revoked.
verifyHints.403: The token's user may not do this. Check the user's site role and permissions.
verifyHints.404: Nothing answered at this address. Check TABLEAU_SERVER_URL: only the scheme and host, and Tableau Server 2024.2 or later.

tools.name: tableau_get_current_session
tools.description: The signed-in session: site (id, name, contentUrl) and user (id, name, site role). The site.id is the site_id every other tool needs; call this first.

tools.name: tableau_get_server_info
tools.description: Product version, build and the newest REST API version of the Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud pod.

tools.name: tableau_list_sites
tools.description: Sites the signed-in user can reach (on Tableau Cloud usually only the signed-in one): id, name, contentUrl, state, admin mode.

tools.name: tableau_get_site
tools.description: Settings of a site: name, contentUrl, state, storage quota, user quota, and which features (subscriptions, flows, Ask Data, ...) are on.

tools.name: tableau_search_content
tools.description: Search the site's content by words: workbooks, views, data sources, projects, flows, metrics, tables, databases. Returns hits.items with type, the content (luid, title, ownerName, projectName, modifiedTime) and usage counts (hitsTotal).

filter.description: Restrict the hits, e.g. type:eq:workbook, type:in:[workbook,datasource], ownerId:in:[luid1,luid2].

order_by.description: Sort, e.g. hitsTotal:desc or hitsSmallSpanTotal:desc (views in the last two weeks).

page.description: Page of hits to return, for the next page after the first.

tools.name: tableau_list_projects
tools.description: Projects (folders) of the site: id, name, description, parent project id, owner, content permissions mode.

filter.description: Filter expression field:operator:value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, has. Fields: name, ownerName, parentProjectId, topLevelProject, createdAt, updatedAt.

sort.description: Sort expression field:asc or field:desc, e.g. name:asc or updatedAt:desc.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. _default_ or _all_, or a list such as id,name,updatedAt.

tools.name: tableau_list_workbooks
tools.description: Workbooks of the site: id, name, contentUrl, project, owner, size, tags, created and updated time, webpageUrl.

filter.description: Filter expression field:operator:value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, has. Fields: name, projectName, ownerName, tags, createdAt, updatedAt, contentUrl, favoritesTotal.

sort.description: Sort expression field:asc or field:desc, e.g. name:asc or updatedAt:desc.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. _default_ or _all_, or a list such as id,name,updatedAt.

tools.name: tableau_get_workbook
tools.description: One workbook: name, description, project, owner, tags, views, data acceleration and freshness settings, webpageUrl.

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_list_workbook_views
tools.description: Views (sheets and dashboards) of a workbook: id, name, contentUrl, and with include_usage_statistics the total view count.

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_list_workbook_connections
tools.description: Data connections of a workbook: type, server address, port, user name, and the published data source behind each.

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_list_views
tools.description: Views of the whole site: id, name, contentUrl, workbook, owner, project, tags, and with include_usage_statistics the view count.

filter.description: Filter expression field:operator:value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, has. Fields: name, workbookName, projectName, ownerName, tags, viewUrlName, createdAt, updatedAt.

sort.description: Sort expression field:asc or field:desc, e.g. name:asc or updatedAt:desc.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. _default_ or _all_, or a list such as id,name,updatedAt.

tools.name: tableau_get_view
tools.description: One view: name, contentUrl, workbook, owner, project, tags, and with include_usage_statistics the view count.

view_id.description: View id (LUID) from tableau_list_views or tableau_list_workbook_views.

tools.name: tableau_get_view_data
tools.description: The data behind a view as CSV text (the summary data of its marks), optionally filtered with vf_ filters. The best way to read the numbers a dashboard sheet shows.

view_id.description: View id (LUID) from tableau_list_views or tableau_list_workbook_views.

max_age.description: Accept a cached rendering up to this many minutes old (minimum 1). Leave out for Tableau's default.

filters.description: View filters as query keys with the vf_ prefix and the field name as shown in the view, e.g. {"vf_Region": "West", "vf_Order Date (Years)": "2026"}. Several values for one field: comma-separated.

tools.name: tableau_get_view_image
tools.description: A PNG image of a view, returned as an image the model can look at, optionally filtered with vf_ filters.

view_id.description: View id (LUID) from tableau_list_views or tableau_list_workbook_views.

viz_width.description: Width in pixels; with viz_height sets size and aspect ratio.

max_age.description: Accept a cached rendering up to this many minutes old (minimum 1). Leave out for Tableau's default.

filters.description: View filters as query keys with the vf_ prefix and the field name as shown in the view, e.g. {"vf_Region": "West", "vf_Order Date (Years)": "2026"}. Several values for one field: comma-separated.

tools.name: tableau_get_view_pdf
tools.description: A PDF of one view, returned as a file, with paper size and orientation, optionally filtered with vf_ filters.

view_id.description: View id (LUID) from tableau_list_views or tableau_list_workbook_views.

type.description: Paper size: A3, A4, A5, B5, Executive, Folio, Ledger, Legal (default), Letter, Note, Quarto, Tabloid.

max_age.description: Accept a cached rendering up to this many minutes old (minimum 1). Leave out for Tableau's default.

filters.description: View filters as query keys with the vf_ prefix and the field name as shown in the view, e.g. {"vf_Region": "West", "vf_Order Date (Years)": "2026"}. Several values for one field: comma-separated.

tools.name: tableau_download_view_crosstab_excel
tools.description: The crosstab of a view as an Excel file (.xlsx), returned as a file, optionally filtered with vf_ filters.

view_id.description: View id (LUID) from tableau_list_views or tableau_list_workbook_views.

max_age.description: Accept a cached rendering up to this many minutes old (minimum 1). Leave out for Tableau's default.

filters.description: View filters as query keys with the vf_ prefix and the field name as shown in the view, e.g. {"vf_Region": "West", "vf_Order Date (Years)": "2026"}. Several values for one field: comma-separated.

tools.name: tableau_get_workbook_pdf
tools.description: A PDF of all views of a workbook, returned as a file, with paper size and orientation.

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

type.description: Paper size: A3, A4, A5, B5, Executive, Folio, Ledger, Legal (default), Letter, Note, Quarto, Tabloid.

max_age.description: Accept a cached rendering up to this many minutes old (minimum 1). Leave out for Tableau's default.

tools.name: tableau_list_datasources
tools.description: Published data sources of the site: id, name, type (database type), project, owner, tags, certification, whether it has an extract, created and updated time.

filter.description: Filter expression field:operator:value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, has. Fields: name, projectName, ownerName, type, isCertified, hasExtracts, tags, updatedAt.

sort.description: Sort expression field:asc or field:desc, e.g. name:asc or updatedAt:desc.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. _default_ or _all_, or a list such as id,name,updatedAt.

tools.name: tableau_get_datasource
tools.description: One published data source: name, description, type, project, owner, certification note, extract and refresh information.

datasource_id.description: Published data source id (LUID) from tableau_list_datasources or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_list_datasource_connections
tools.description: Connections of a published data source: type, server address, port, user name.

datasource_id.description: Published data source id (LUID) from tableau_list_datasources or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_read_datasource_metadata
tools.description: Fields of a published data source through the VizQL Data Service: fieldCaption (the name to use in queries), dataType, role (dimension or measure), default aggregation, description. Call it before tableau_query_datasource.

datasource_id.description: Published data source id (LUID) from tableau_list_datasources or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_query_datasource
tools.description: Query a published data source through the VizQL Data Service: pick fields (dimensions and aggregated measures), filters and sorting, get rows back as objects. Tableau Cloud or Tableau Server 2025.1 and later.

datasource_id.description: Published data source id (LUID) from tableau_list_datasources or tableau_search_content.

query.description: The query: {"fields": [{"fieldCaption": "Region"}, {"fieldCaption": "Sales", "function": "SUM", "sortDirection": "DESC", "sortPriority": 1}], "filters": [{"field": {"fieldCaption": "Order Date"}, "filterType": "QUANTITATIVE_DATE", "quantitativeFilterType": "RANGE", "minDate": "2026-01-01", "maxDate": "2026-06-30"}]}. Functions: SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX, COUNT, COUNTD, MEDIAN, YEAR, QUARTER, MONTH, WEEK, DAY, TRUNC_MONTH, ... Filter types: SET, MATCH, QUANTITATIVE_NUMERICAL, QUANTITATIVE_DATE, DATE (relative), TOP.

tools.name: tableau_metadata_query
tools.description: Run a GraphQL query on the Tableau Metadata API for lineage: which workbooks use a data source, upstream databases and tables, columns, calculated fields, owners, data quality warnings. Read-only.

query.description: GraphQL query, e.g. { publishedDatasources(filter: {luid: "..."}) { name downstreamWorkbooks { name luid } upstreamTables { name schema database { name } } } }.

variables.description: GraphQL variables, if the query declares any.

tools.name: tableau_list_users
tools.description: Users of the site: id, name, full name, e-mail, site role (Creator, Explorer, Viewer, SiteAdministratorCreator, Unlicensed, ...), last login, auth setting.

filter.description: Filter expression field:operator:value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, has. Fields: name, friendlyName, siteRole, lastLogin, email, domainName.

sort.description: Sort expression field:asc or field:desc, e.g. name:asc or updatedAt:desc.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. _default_ or _all_, or a list such as id,name,updatedAt.

tools.name: tableau_get_user
tools.description: One user: name, full name, e-mail, site role, last login, external auth id.

tools.name: tableau_list_user_groups
tools.description: Groups a user belongs to: group id, name, domain and minimum site role.

tools.name: tableau_list_groups
tools.description: Groups of the site: id, name, domain, minimum site role and user count.

filter.description: Filter expression field:operator:value, several joined by commas (all must match). Operators: eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, has. Fields: name, domainName, minimumSiteRole, isLocal, userCount.

sort.description: Sort expression field:asc or field:desc, e.g. name:asc or updatedAt:desc.

fields.description: Fields to return, e.g. _default_ or _all_, or a list such as id,name,updatedAt.

tools.name: tableau_list_group_users
tools.description: Members of a group: user id, name, full name, site role and last login.

tools.name: tableau_list_jobs
tools.description: Background jobs of the site (extract refreshes, subscriptions, flows): id, type, status, progress, created, started and ended time.

filter.description: Filter, e.g. jobType:eq:refresh_extracts, progress:lt:100, status:eq:Failed, createdAt:gt:2026-10-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: tableau_get_job
tools.description: Status of one job: progress (0 to 100), finishCode (0 success, 1 failed, 2 cancelled), notes with the error text, and the workbook or data source it works on.

job_id.description: Job id from tableau_list_jobs or from a refresh answer (job.id).

tools.name: tableau_list_extract_refresh_tasks
tools.description: Scheduled extract refresh tasks of the site: task id, priority, type (full or incremental), schedule (frequency and next run time), and the workbook or data source refreshed.

tools.name: tableau_refresh_workbook
tools.description: Refresh the extracts of a workbook now. Returns a job; follow it with tableau_get_job.

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_refresh_datasource
tools.description: Refresh the extract of a published data source now. Returns a job; follow it with tableau_get_job.

datasource_id.description: Published data source id (LUID) from tableau_list_datasources or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_run_extract_refresh_task
tools.description: Run a scheduled extract refresh task now instead of waiting for its schedule. Returns a job; follow it with tableau_get_job.

tools.name: tableau_cancel_job
tools.description: Cancel a running or queued job (an extract refresh, a subscription or a flow run). A cancelled job cannot be resumed; it has to be started again.

job_id.description: Job id from tableau_list_jobs or from a refresh answer (job.id).

tools.name: tableau_create_project
tools.description: Create a project, at the top level or inside a parent project.

parent_project_id.description: Parent project id; leave out for a top-level project.

tools.name: tableau_update_project
tools.description: Rename a project, change its description or content permissions, or move it under another parent. Only the fields you pass change.

tools.name: tableau_update_workbook
tools.description: Rename a workbook or switch its tabs on or off. Only the fields you pass change; tableau_move_workbook moves it to another project.

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

show_tabs.description: true shows the views as tabs.

tools.name: tableau_move_workbook
tools.description: Move a workbook to another project (its permissions may follow the target project's settings).

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_add_workbook_tags
tools.description: Add tags to a workbook; existing tags stay, the answer lists all tags of the workbook.

workbook_id.description: Workbook id (LUID) from tableau_list_workbooks or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_add_datasource_tags
tools.description: Add tags to a published data source; existing tags stay, the answer lists all of them.

datasource_id.description: Published data source id (LUID) from tableau_list_datasources or tableau_search_content.

tools.name: tableau_add_user_to_group
tools.description: Add a user of the site to a group (local groups only; Active Directory groups sync from the directory).
